findings.conclusion: CodexRemoteThreadToolbarContent chooses ToolbarItemPlacement.principal on iOS26+, topBarLeading otherwise. The content factory is1ce909c and concrete label metadata accessor1ce9184. Helper1da9ebc tail-calls ToolbarItem.init(placement:content:) at7c46e10, bound at aad02e8.

findings.conclusion: After the DynamicType cap, the LocationLabel receives _FrameLayout(width:nil,height:44,alignment:center). findings.integration: Apply .frame(height:44) to the complete title/subtitle label after .dynamicTypeSize(...xLarge). This is fixed height, not minHeight, maxWidth infinity, or a screenshot-derived horizontal offset.

findings.conclusion: The title ToolbarItem passes visibility raw2 to756b500. The wrapper stores the byte, then on iOS26+ calls ToolbarContent.sharedBackgroundVisibility with that byte. Apple SDK frozen Visibility cases are automatic,visible,hidden, so raw2 maps to hidden. Before26 wrapper returns original toolbar content.
findings.integration: Apply .sharedBackgroundVisibility(.hidden) to the title ToolbarItem on iOS26+. This has a direct source basis. Its actual impact on system title positioning must be measured separately.

findings.conclusion: The inspected immediate label factory constructs data plus the xLarge cap. The immediate toolbar modifier attaches .toolbar(content:).
